<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Animal Strength](/Feats.aspx?ID=5410) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 59

**Prerequisites**
[_animal feature_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1866) warden spell

</column>

---

You tap into the primal strength of your _animal feature_. When you gain a claw or jaws attack from _animal feature_, you can choose a weapon you're carrying and apply all runes from that weapon (if they're applicable) to that [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack. This replaces any runes the unarmed attacks would normally have from other sources, like [_handwraps of mighty blows_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3086). In addition, when you critically hit with a claw or jaws attack from animal feature, you deal 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
name: Animal Strength
